description_en: Queries the resource reservations of NAT gateway instances
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-nat-gateway-capacity-reservation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dry-run false --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe637760 --nat-gateway-id 'ngw-bp1uewa15k4iy5770****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNatGatewayCapacityReservation

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for this request. Valid values:
true: sends a dry run request without querying the resource status. The system checks whether your AccessKey pair is valid, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and whether the required parameters are specified. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried
parameters.help_zh: 是否只预检此次请求，取值：true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, and you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters. Note: If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway to query
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

Reason.description_en: The reason for the processing failure

Status.description_en:
The resource reservation status. Valid values:

pending: The reservation is in progress.

provisioned: The reservation is completed.

failed: The reservation failed.

deleting: The reservation is being deleted.

deleted: The reservation is deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源预留状态。取值：

pending 预留中。

provisioned 已预留。

failed 预留失败。

deleting 删除中。

deleted 已删除

DecreaseRequestsRemaining.description_en: The remaining number of times that you can downgrade or cancel the resource reservation
DecreaseRequestsRemaining.description_zh: 剩余降配、取消资源预留的次数

LastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the resource reservation was last modified
LastModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后一次修改资源预留的时间

NatGatewayCapacity.description_en: The number of capacity units (CUs) reserved for the NAT gateway

CapacityUnits.description_en: The number of load balancer capacity units (LCUs) reserved per hour

NatGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the NAT gateway to query

NatGatewayPerformanceValues.description_en: The performance metrics of the NAT gateway resource reservation

Cps.description_en: The number of new connections per second

Pps.description_en: The number of packets per second
